summary.text: Dustin Miller is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 40, representing St. Landry, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2015 as the year elected.
The page lists Dustin Miller with committee assignments including Health and Welfare (Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Dustin Miller's occupation as Nursing.
It lists Dustin Miller's education as Opelousas Catholic High School; B.S.N., University of Louisiana at Lafayette; M.S.N., Family Nursing, Southern University.

The House member page lists Dustin Miller's committee assignments as Health and Welfare (Chair); Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee; Joint Medicaid Oversight Committee; Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
